bias_targets.methodology: Generating text using GPT-2 with gender-specific demographic terms (e.g., 'man', 'woman') in standardized contexts (respect and occupation tasks), and evaluating the generated sentences using a regard classifier.

Generating text using GPT-2 with race-specific demographic terms (e.g., 'Black', 'White') in standardized contexts, and evaluating the sentiment/regard of the generated sentences using a regard classifier.
Generating text using GPT-2 with sexual orientation-specific demographic terms (e.g., 'straight', 'gay') in standardized contexts, and evaluating the outputs using a regard classifier.
Generating text using combinations of gender, race, and sexual orientation identities (e.g., 'Black Gay Woman') to evaluate compound social biases using a regard classifier.
